__broaden__.ἐφ: ἐπί (elided ἐφ’ before a rough breathing) — on, upon, over; + dat. ’on’ · also + acc., ’to, towards’ · also in ὅσσον ἐφ’ …, ἐπί of unclear attachment: ’(lying) on, at’ · also + dat., ’against’ (Τρωσὶν ἐφ’ ἱπποδάμοισιν ’against the Trojans’) · also + gen., ’by oneself’ (ἐφ’ ὑμείων ’by yourselves, apart’) · also + gen., ’upon’ (ἐφ’ ὑμετέρων ὀχέων ’upon your chariot’) · also + gen., ’over, around’ (ἐφ’ ὁμίλου ’over the crowd’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐφ’ ἱπποπόλων Θρῃκῶν ’toward the horse-herding Thracians’) · also + acc., ’over’ (ἐφ’ ὑγρὴν ’over the water’) · also preverb in tmesis, ἐφ’ … ἔχευε = ἐπέχευε ’poured upon’, + acc. as object (ἐφ’ ὕπνον ἔχευε ’poured sleep upon’)
__broaden__.περὶ: περί — around; + gen.: ’beyond, above’, or adv. ’exceedingly’ · also preverb in tmesis ’all round’ · also adv. in tmesis with εἰμί: ’surpass’ (περὶ … ἐστέ) · also + dat. of place: ’around’ (περὶ δουρί ’around the spear’) · also with ἀμφί, both before an accusative, ’round about’ (ἀμφὶ περὶ κρήνην ’round about a spring’) · also prep. + acc. of place: ’around’ (περὶ Δωδώνην ’around Dodona’) · also + gen., ’about, for the sake of’ (μαχήσονται περὶ σεῖο ’will fight about you’) · also adv. ’around, about’ (περὶ … ἦσαν ’were around’) · also adv., ’round about, on every side’ (περὶ κτείνοντο ’were killed all around’) · also adv. ’beyond others’ with the dat. of respect: ’by far’ (περὶ ἔγχει … φέρτατος ’best by far with the spear’) · also prep. + dat., of concern: ’for, over’ (περὶ ξανθῷ Μενελάῳ ’for fair-haired Menelaus’) · also prep. + acc. of the thing contended for: ’over’ (περὶ τεύχε’ ’over the armour’) · also + gen. with λείπομαι: ’left over from’ (πολέμοιο περὶ … λίπωνται ’are left over from the war’) · also + acc., of concern: ’about, busy over’ (περὶ δόρπα πονέοντο ’were busy about the meal’)
__broaden__.ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’) · also adv. ’away, off’ before πρό (ἀπὸ πρὸ νεῶν ’off in front of the ships’) · also + gen. of manner: ’from’ (ἀπὸ σπουδῆς ’in earnest’) · also with a noun in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπὸ νευρῆφιν ’from the string’) · also + a form in -θεν, ablatival: ’from’ (ἀπὸ Τροίηθεν ’from Troy’)
__broaden__.ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’) · also ὥς before the enclitic τοι, in a clause after πείθεο: ’as’ (ὥς τοι … θείω ’as I set for you’) · also ὥς accented before the enclitic τις (ὥς τίς τε λέων ’like some lion’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μευ, ’that’, after a verb of remembering (ὥς μευ ἀεὶ μέμνησαι ’that you always remember me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic σφιν, temporal: ’when, as when’ (ὥς σφιν πρῶτον ἀπήχθετο ’when first it became hateful to them’) · also ὥς before the enclitic περ, ’as, just as’ (τηλίκου ὥς περ ἐγών ’of an age as I am’)
